answer:
Verdict: no

Across filestore (PID 639364), opens were **10.1/s** (305 total), closes **10.2/s** (308 total), and file create/delete/rename operations **0.3/s** (9 total). These are well below hundreds per second.

The thread-level counts show **reader (TID 639367)** made 298 opens and 298 closes; **writer (TID 639366)** made 2 of each; and the main **filestore thread (TID 639364)** made 5 opens and 1 unlink. The trace’s file-name totals were 300 opens and 300 closes of `data/records.dat`, plus one open and close of `program.log`. The findings do not map each thread’s operations to specific file names.
